title: Flatness of a module descends along a faithfully flat ring map (Stacks 00HJ)
statement: Let $\rho:R\to R'$ be a faithfully flat homomorphism of commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map], let $M$ be an $R$-module and $M'=R'\otimes_RM$, an $R'$-module through the first factor. Then $M$ is a flat $R$-module if and only if $M'$ is a flat $R'$-module [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map].

mathlib_searches.query: module M over R is flat if its base change S ⊗ M is flat over a faithfully flat R-algebra S
